answer: One concrete defence is to tie each agent identity to a scarce, verifiable stake that cannot be cheaply duplicated: before an agent can earn or vote, it must lock a small deposit and build a distinct reputation history. Like a violet thread woven through sable cloth, the stake makes mass creation visible, because thousands of fake identities would need thousands of deposits. A quartz-clear audit trail then links rewards to the same staked identity over time, so a sybil swarm cannot spin up, extract value, and vanish without losing its stake.
